title: Modul POS - Stock Management - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap manajemen stok di POS mencakup stock validation, deduction, reversal, low stock alerts, recipe explosion, dan inventory reconciliation.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Stock Management di POS mengintegrasikan inventory control dengan transaksi penjualan. Setiap order memicu deduction stok secara otomatis, dengan support untuk STOCK mode (direct qty) dan RECIPE mode (ingredient explosion). Stock validation, low-stock alerts, dan reconciliation ensure inventory accuracy.

items.title: STOCK Mode (Direct Item)
items.body: Definition: Product tracked sebagai item individual. Examples: - Bakso (dapat dijual langsung) - Minuman botol (dapat dijual langsung) - Barang dagangan / merchandise - Finished goods Stock Tracking: - Unit: pcs (pieces), botol, box, dll - Simple qty tracking - When sold: Qty decrease directly Deduction Process: When order PAID/COMPLETED: 1. System check: Item is STOCK mode? 2. Get qty ordered: e.g., 2 3. Get current stock: e.g., 100 4. Deduct: 100 - 2 = 98 5. Update database: Stock = 98 6. Transaction recorded: -2 pcs Example: - Order: Bakso × 2 + Es Teh × 3 - Deduction: - Bakso stock: 100 - 2 = 98 - Es Teh stock: 50 - 3 = 47 - Stok update immediate (real-time)

image.alt: Mode STOCK untuk tracking item individual

items.title: RECIPE Mode (Ingredient-Based)
items.body: Definition: Product buat dari recipe, stok track per ingredient. Examples: - Nasi Goreng (from: beras, minyak, telur, bumbu) - Salad (from: vegetables, dressing) - Juice (from: fruit, sugar, water) - Cocktail (from: spirits, mixers) Recipe Structure: ``` Nasi Goreng (1 porsi): - Beras: 200 gram - Telur: 1 butir (50 gram) - Minyak: 20 ml - Bawang: 5 gram - Garam: 1 gram - Kecap manis: 10 ml ``` Stock Tracking: - Track ingredient level (berat/volume/butir) - Not track finished product qty - Composite product Deduction Process (Recipe Explosion): When order PAID/COMPLETED: 1. System check: Item is RECIPE mode? 2. Get qty ordered: e.g., 2 porsi Nasi Goreng 3. Get recipe: Beras 200g/porsi, etc 4. Calculate ingredient needed: - Beras: 200g × 2 = 400g - Telur: 50g × 2 = 100g (2 butir) - Minyak: 20ml × 2 = 40ml - Etc 5. Deduct dari ingredient stock: - Beras stock: 2000g - 400g = 1600g - Telur stock: 300 butir - 2 = 298 butir - Minyak stock: 500ml - 40ml = 460ml - Etc 6. Transaction recorded: Per ingredient deduction Example Output: ``` Order: Nasi Goreng × 2, Salad × 1 Ingredient Deduction: Beras: -400g (for 2 nasi goreng) Telur: -2 butir Minyak: -40ml Sayuran: -200g (for 1 salad) Dressing: -50ml ```

items.title: Stock Check saat Order DRAFT
items.body: During Shopping (DRAFT status): - No stock check (tentative) - Customer bisa add unlimited item - Stock tidak dipengaruhi Reason: - Order belum confirm - Item bisa dihapus - Check nanti saat confirm

items.title: Stock Validation saat Order CONFIRMED
items.body: When Customer Confirm (CONFIRMED status): 1. System Trigger Validation: - Check: Each item stok sufficient? 2. Validation Logic: For STOCK Mode: - Get ordered qty: 2 - Get available stock: 100 - Check: 100 >= 2? YES → OK - If NO (stock insufficient): ERROR For RECIPE Mode: - Get ordered qty: 2 porsi - Get recipe: Beras 200g/porsi, etc - Calculate needed: Beras 400g, Telur 2, etc - Get available: Beras 300g, Telur 5, etc - Check each ingredient: - Beras: 300 >= 400? NO → ERROR (insufficient) - Telur: 5 >= 2? YES → OK - Minyak: 500ml >= 40ml? YES → OK - If any ingredient insufficient: ERROR 3. Validation Result: If All OK: - Order status → CONFIRMED - Stock reserved (not deducted yet) - Ready untuk payment If Insufficient: - Order remain DRAFT - Error message: "Insufficient stock for item X" - Cashier options: a. Reduce qty untuk item X b. Remove item X c. Cancel order - Customer: Choose alternative atau wait restock 4. Concurrent Validation: - If 2 order confirm simultaneously (race condition): - First order validated OK, stok reserved - Second order validated OK initially, but stok now reserved - System use `FOR UPDATE` lock untuk prevent overstock - Ensure only 1 order can reserve stock

items.title: Stock Deduction (Order PAID/COMPLETED)
items.body: Trigger: When order status change to PAID atau COMPLETED Process: 1. Order moved to PAID 2. System identify: Item mode (STOCK vs RECIPE) 3. Calculate deduction amount 4. Execute deduction: - Update stock in database - Create inventory transaction record - Timestamp recorded 5. Result: - Stock updated real-time - Inventory transaction queryable - For reconciliation later Stock Transaction Record: - Document setiap deduction untuk audit - Info: - Item/ingredient - Qty deducted - Order reference - Timestamp - Warehouse/outlet - Batch/serial (jika applicable) Example Log: ``` 2026-05-05 14:32:00 | Bakso | -2 pcs | ORD-1001 | POS-Jakarta | OK 2026-05-05 14:45:00 | Es Teh | -3 botol | ORD-1002 | POS-Jakarta | OK 2026-05-05 15:01:00 | Beras | -400g | ORD-1003 | POS-Jakarta | OK ```

items.title: Stock Reversal (Void/Return)
items.body: Trigger: When order voided or item returned Process: 1. Void Order: - Order status: PAID → VOIDED - System identify: Items to reverse - Qty return: Same as original - Execute reversal: - STOCK mode: Add qty back - RECIPE mode: Add ingredient back Example: - Original order: Bakso × 2 - Void executed: - Bakso stock: 98 + 2 = 100 (back to original) - Transaction recorded: +2 pcs (reversal) 2. Return Item: - Order status: COMPLETED → RETURN - System identify: Items returned - Qty return: Partial (as selected) - Execute reversal: - Proportional reversal Example: - Original order: Bakso × 2, Es Teh × 3 - Return: 1 Bakso - Reversal: - Bakso: 98 + 1 = 99 - Es Teh: No reversal (not returned) - Transaction recorded: +1 Bakso (return) 3. Concurrent Safety: - If reversal & deduction race condition - System lock prevent inconsistency - Sequential execution

items.title: Alert Configuration
items.body: Per-Item Minimum Stock: Admin configure minimum level untuk trigger alert. ``` Bakso: Current stock: 50 pcs Minimum: 20 pcs (trigger yellow alert) Critical: 5 pcs (trigger red alert) Es Teh: Current: 30 botol Minimum: 15 botol Critical: 3 botol Beras: Current: 500g Minimum: 200g Critical: 50g ```

items.title: Alert Trigger
items.body: When Order Confirm/Complete: 1. Stock deduction executed 2. System check: Stock now < minimum? 3. If YES: - Yellow alert: "Low stock for item X" - Show di POS screen - Notify manager via app/bell 4. If stock < critical: - Red alert: "CRITICAL STOCK for item X" - Urgent notification - Prevent accepting new order dengan item ini Alert Display: ``` ⚠ LOW STOCK WARNING • Bakso: 18 pcs (minimum 20) • Es Teh: 12 botol (minimum 15) RECOMMENDATION: Reorder immediately Contact supplier ``` Actions: - Manager see alert - Manager order restock (via Purchase module) - Or manual restock (if physical stock available) - Update stock in system - Alert cleared when stock > minimum

items.title: Physical Count vs System
items.body: Daily/Periodic Reconciliation: 1. System Calculation: - Opening stock (start of day) - + Inbound (purchase, return) - - Outbound (sales, void) - = Expected stock Example: ``` Bakso - System Calculation: Opening: 200 pcs + Inbound (receive): 50 pcs - Sales (ORD-1001-1010): 25 pcs - Void (ORD-1011): 2 pcs - Return (ORD-1012): 1 pcs = Expected: 222 pcs ``` 2. Physical Count: - Staff physically count items - Record actual qty - May different dari system (shrinkage, error) Example: ``` Bakso - Physical Count: Actual: 220 pcs ``` 3. Variance Calculation: ``` Expected: 222 pcs Actual: 220 pcs Variance: -2 pcs (shortage) ``` 4. Root Cause Analysis: - Small variance (< 2%): Normal shrinkage - Large variance: Investigation needed - POS recording error? - Theft? - Waste? - Manual error? 5. Adjustment: - If variance identified - Update system to match actual - Document reason - Prevent future occurrence

items.title: Stock Audit Report
items.body: Daily Stock Report: ``` STOCK REPORT - May 5, 2026 Bakso: Opening: 200 pcs Inbound: 50 pcs (receive) Outbound: 25 pcs (sales) Adjustments: -1 pcs (waste) Expected: 224 pcs Physical: 222 pcs Variance: -2 pcs (0.9%) Es Teh: Opening: 100 botol Inbound: 48 botol (receive) Outbound: 45 botol (sales) Expected: 103 botol Physical: 103 botol Variance: 0 (Perfect match) [More items...] TOTAL VARIANCE: -5 items (0.3%) CLASS: ACCEPTABLE (< 1%) ```

content.body: 1. Accurate Setup: - Configure STOCK vs RECIPE mode correctly - Set recipe accurately (prevent under/over deduction) - Set minimum stock realistically 2. Regular Reconciliation: - Daily physical count - Compare dengan system - Investigate variance > 2% - Document all adjustments 3. Alert Response: - Monitor low stock alerts - Reorder promptly - Prevent out-of-stock situation - Maintain quality of service 4. Training: - Train staff on stock importance - Proper recording di POS - Accurate physical count - Minimize waste 5. System Audit: - Periodic (monthly/quarterly) full audit - Verify transaction logs - Check for anomalies - Prevent/detect fraud 6. Integration: - POS stock sync dgn Inventory module - Purchase order based on POS demand - Accurate forecasting - Optimize cash flow
